name: World Engine
invariants: same lat/lon/span/samples/seed yields the same procedural terrain
WGS84 coordinates remain the navigation frame
procedural generation is a rendering/world fallback and does not modify vehicle physics
external DEM may override terrain heights without changing the common world-state contract
craft/instrument changes preserve the last shared WGS84 world state through same-origin storage and broadcast
astronomical or experimental instrument state may consume the shared world anchor without rewriting measured source data
